acceptance: The collector records cold and warm capture, hand-off, steady-state flush p50 and p95, renderer CPU per cycle, RSS and peak RSS, heap per node and heap growth over repeated rounds for 1k, 10k and 50k nodes.

positive.fixture: 1k/10k/50k nodes: cold p50 32/133/505 ms, flush p95 0.6/0.6/1.8 ms

negative.fixture: regression guards: flush p95 under 10 ms, cold p95 under 3 s and heap growth under 2 MiB at 3k nodes

security_and_source_permissions: The observer reads structure and declared labels only; form values are never read, credential regions yield no text, account text is flagged and withheld from shared evidence, and no network surface exists.
performance_memory_storage: Peak RSS 505 vs 350 MiB control at 50k nodes; heap 370 B per node; growth 180496 B over 4 rounds of 300 cycles.
known_limitations: Hand-off time includes the Playwright binding serialization and is an upper bound for in-browser transport
